title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. translated_title: MM-SystemOneBias：评估多模态Jev式系统一决策模型中的偏差
translated_abstract: 当多模态决策模型执行动作判定、内容审核或质量评估时，其可靠性取决于在呈现方式变化下保持语义决策的一致性、忽略无关的附加信息，并区分与任务证据一致的信息和与之冲突的信息。现有评估分别在不同设置下研究决策界面偏差和多模态模型行为，缺乏统一协议来在实际任务上比较多模态决策模型与其骨干模型。我们提出MM-SystemOneBias，在来自九个公共数据集、11个任务场景的5,323个原始实例上评估13个模型，采用六种配对干预：选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图像-文本描述、无关信息和评分量表。在七组匹配的决策模型-骨干模型对中，决策模型在选项标签、无关信息和评分量表等干预下表现出更强的稳定性。
tldr: 提出MM-SystemOneBias基准，通过六种配对干预在11个任务场景、5,323个实例上系统评估13个多模态决策模型的偏差，发现决策模型在选项标签、无关信息和评分量表干预下比其骨干模型更稳定。
en_tdlr: MM-SystemOneBias evaluates 13 multimodal decision models across 11 task scenarios and 5,323 instances using six paired interventions, showing that decision models are more stable than their backbones under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale perturbations.
